name: Tenjou Ura kara Ai o Komete
original_name: 天井裏から愛をこめて
source:
Main character dreams of having a harem. One day he becomes an owner of a female-only apartment. There is a hidden passage to reach any room any time he wants. The daily effort to peek and observe in search of approach to each girl starts.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-august-2002-ever17-out-of.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公梦想拥有一座后宫。一天，他成为一栋女性专用公寓的房东。楼内藏有秘密通道，让他随时都能潜入任何房间。于是，他开始每天偷窥、观察，寻找接近每位女孩的办法。

[引自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-august-2002-ever17-out-of.html]vndbreview[/url]]
